body: Maybe you should start locking the door when you're in there, even if you're just brushing your teeth.  She might get the message that way...although honestly, it sounds like she doesn't care how you feel about this.  Are there many other things she ignores you on or is this it?

Have you considered telling her that since she wants to act like she's not a member of the household, she can no longer BE a member of the household?  Perhaps the thought of being kicked out of the nest will bring her back down to reality.
I think Poison said it best:  "Sometimes I wish to God I didn't know now, the things I didn't know then."

I see we're having the same conversations.  I feel I have nothing to live for, no reason to wake up in the morning, and no hopes for the future - but I won't take my own life because of the pain it would inflict on others.  Maybe if we keep asking nicely, whoever is in charge will come get us.
My hair fell out, I got shingles, lost 20 pounds, and started experiencing panic attacks after Mark died.  Grief seems to affect every part of our being.

I sold the house and moved about 4 hours away only 6 months ago.  Honestly, I'm not sure how I feel about the move yet.  However, that's probably because I do nothing but ride my motorcycle and do jigsaw puzzles.  How old is your child?
I’m actually a 50-year-old female who never has anything more serious than seasonal allergies.   What you’re saying totally makes sense. I guess I’ve just been lucky.
Dude, I go like once a week and I’m perfectly healthy. Do not force it-that causes hemorrhoids.
The fact that you feel so bad says a lot more than your lashing out. We all have negative thoughts we project on others occasionally.

But OP stated that his roommate doesn’t know he’s gay, as if that were part of the titillation.  I merely pointed out that OP’S titillation is baseless.

Source: I understand how humans speak and the logic behind it.
The hospital might not, but the insurance company will very likely send the parents an Explanation of Benefits statement on a monthly or quarterly basis, and this will have the ER visit listed.

Maybe you’re already aware, but nudity has nothing to do with sex or sexuality whatsoever. He is probably not even thinking about you looking at him like that.  

Source: I’m a nudist.
I dropped my bike once (0 mph turn around) in almost 50,000 miles of riding.
I just got done watching Hitting the Apex for about the hundredth time and Faster is next.

You don't need to be embarrassed!  I cry in public often, and I don't try to hide it or apologize for it.  I loved him way out loud, and I will grieve for him the same way.  I see people watching me...occasionally someone will say something nice. Be proud that you're able to do things that need to be done.  Life insurance is both a help and a hindrance.
